products.name: Tree Job Readiness Gate
products.product: A focused tree service permit utility and site readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent arborist, pruning, removal, and plant-health-care companies
products.problem: Approved tree work reaches the crew without confirmed permits, utility coordination, access, equipment, traffic control, neighbor constraints, or current tree scope.
products.valueProposition: Turns tree service permit utility and site readiness into a visible operating queue so every tree job is released only with site-specific scope, permissions, hazards, equipment, and access verified for the assigned crew.
products.topic: tree service permit utility and site readiness
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets tree service job checklist, arborist permit tracker, tree removal job readiness, and tree crew work packet searches.

products.name: Tree Job Closeout
products.product: A focused tree service cleanup and stump closeout tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent arborist, pruning, removal, and plant-health-care companies
products.problem: A removal or pruning crew can leave while debris, stump work, wood disposition, property damage, permit conditions, customer walkthrough, or invoice evidence remains unresolved.
products.valueProposition: Turns tree service cleanup and stump closeout tracking into a visible operating queue so every tree job closes with contracted scope, site cleanup, retained materials, follow-on work, and customer-facing evidence reconciled.
products.topic: tree service cleanup and stump closeout tracking

products.seoAngle: Targets tree service completion checklist, tree removal cleanup, stump grinding follow up, and arborist job closeout searches.
